bio: Oddfellows is a stylish boutique hotel, housed within a stunning Georgian townhouse in the middle of the beautiful city of Chester, only moments from the River Dee and Chester Race course.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Secret Garden Restaurant, which offers the perfect atmosphere to relax with the great British ritual of Afternoon Tea. Modern accents, lush greenery and quirky decor combine to make The Secret Garden a unique dining experience.
